delays_ms.note: trigger is a native lower bound read before the request, so trigger-based delays are upper bounds of the true request delay

reference_at_takeover.mechanism: RAPTOR internal capture (current position and yaw, zero velocity)

primary.max_altitude_loss_definition: max over [trigger, window end] of descent below the altitude at the trigger

observation_quality.alignment: backward as-of only; fresh sample after source gap restarts continuity

primary.window_constraints_note: Window = [trigger, end of post_event phase]. Safety envelope plus P0 hover error/tilt limits applied to the active controller target; unchanged p0.json thresholds.

saturation_definition.note: actuator_motors control in [0,1]; upper/lower limit within 1e-3

curves.note: every 5th local-position sample for figures; time relative to the actual change
